verdict.rationale: Stripe's first-party docs say agents can connect through an official Stripe MCP server ('Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server'), and a probe confirmed the documented MCP page. That covers every element of the story: an official server that agents connect to. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and documentation in the pack of which Billing operations (subscriptions, invoices, meters) the MCP tools expose or how authentication works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
